bootstrap.simultaneous_method: Bonferroni family-eight one-sided percentile lower bounds

claim_support: a DGP-by-endpoint claim is supported iff its fixed simultaneous lower bound is strictly greater than zero

overall_mapping.domain_robust_gate_execution_invalid: any required integrity failure; precedence over scientific calls
overall_mapping.domain_robust_gate_failed: clean confirmation with zero of eight claims supported, or independently verified preregistered preconfirmation no-candidate/power-infeasibility scientific outcome
overall_mapping.domain_robust_gate_partial: clean confirmation with one through seven of eight claims supported
overall_mapping.domain_robust_gate_confirmed: clean confirmation with all eight claims supported

required_integrity: sealed consumed evidence and exact Git head
full hash-chained research ledger and legal chronology
immutable attempt and legal zero-confirmation version-forward history
complete source/path/hash/byte manifests without aliases or symlinks
contact and privileged fields excluded from fit selection routing retention and analysis
fit-only transforms and all candidate objects locked before selection open
fixed deterministic selection ranking and no post-selection refit
fixed power-selected common confirmation size before smoke
exact sparse calls reconstructed from independently rebuilt causal features and gate objects
two independent gate and total-compute derivations agree
seeded comparator uses equal or weakly more total compute
all confirmation inputs sealed before first target-array analysis
all producer bootstrap arrays reproduced elementwise
